entries.claim: The hand-point residual behaves differently from the contact-map residual: on TACO its change is partly predicted even by the causal predictor (22 / 36 / 46 % of the last-value error removed at 1 / 4 / 8 frames; 31 / 57 / 62 % with the future structure) and at eight frames carrying it forward is worse than a zero residual; on ARCTIC the causal predictor removes 11 % at one frame and nothing distinguishable from zero at 4 and 8 frames (19 / 24 / 20 % with the future structure).
